notes.title: Small patch v1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Just released a small patch correcting a few issues.


 Improved Steam Rich Presence integration
 Fixed an incorrect interaction with ice blocks - pushing an ice block over a sunk stone that had something else on top of it, would make the ice block pass through, instead of being stopped

notes.title: Sokobos 2 Release Date
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, I'm excited to announce that Sokobos 2 will be releasing next month on Friday - 19th of September!



The game's base price will be $9.99 or your regional equivalent and will be 15% off during its launch.



I hope you are looking forward to the release and will enjoy the game when it launches.

— Martin

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes: Hi everyone, just updated the demo with gamepad support (Both Xbox and Playstation controllers) and also included Japanese and Simplified Chinese localization!
